classes.name: EvaluationExecutionLifecycle
classes.description: Deep private Chisei module whose interface executes or cancels one resolved Evaluation manifest and owns durable creation and replay, frozen budgets, evaluator availability, per-manifest serialization, cancellation persistence, worker dispatch, Evidence loading, step and gate receipt ordering, recovery, and terminal cleanup.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates Evaluation execution callers, authorizes namespace access, resolves the durable manifest, translates protocol messages, and delegates execution or cancellation to the Evaluation execution lifecycle.

relations.name: delegates_evaluation_execution_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates execution and cancellation after caller authentication, namespace authorization, and manifest lookup.
